title: Record V45 in the shipped words and cap brackets
body:
## Summary
- Both shipped words end helpers 249, 251, 265 and 267 on the rank-7 subspace. The parent already contains those helpers, on a rank-8 frame.
- Private buffers go from 86 to 91. The five new keys are the later extractions 226, 228, 230, 363 and 395, so V45 adds none.
- The recorded fixed-capacity brackets rise from the parent through stage 1, stage 2 and the final certificate. The cap basis is not re-solved, and there is no new exponent.
